info.title: Kayan Orphan Care — AI Agent Platform (Mock)
info.description: Prototype backend simulating جمعية كيان للايتام beneficiary management. Multi-channel (Voice/SIP + WhatsApp), Arabic-first. Each route is an agent tool.

tags: 1 · التسجيل وملف المستفيد | Registration & Beneficiary File
post.summary: Check if a phone number is already registered
post.description: Mirrors the portal message 'رقم الجوال مسجل مسبقا'. Returns whether an account exists so the agent can route the caller to login instead of re-registering. Always call this before starting a new registration.

tags: 1 · التسجيل وملف المستفيد | Registration & Beneficiary File
post.summary: Send an OTP verification code
post.description: Sends the رمز التحقق by SMS to start account creation or password reset. Code is returned in the response for prototype testing only.

tags: 1 · التسجيل وملف المستفيد | Registration & Beneficiary File
post.summary: Verify the OTP code
post.description: Verifies the رمز التحقق. On success the caller may create the account.

tags: 1 · التسجيل وملف المستفيد | Registration & Beneficiary File
post.summary: Check eligibility for Kayan's served category
post.description: Kayan serves orphans with special circumstances (مجهولي الابوين). The bot must confirm the category before collecting a full file, exactly as the officer does in the guide's WhatsApp sample. Non-eligible callers are politely referred elsewhere.

tags: 1 · التسجيل وملف المستفيد | Registration & Beneficiary File
post.summary: Create a new beneficiary file
post.description: Creates the file (تسجيل مستفيد جديد or تسجيل اسرة بديلة) in draft state with only what the caller gave so far. Remaining sections are filled progressively — call /beneficiary/{id}/completeness to see what is still needed.

tags: 1 · التسجيل وملف المستفيد | Registration & Beneficiary File
get.description: Returns the sections of نموذج البيانات in order, with their field names — use this to walk the caller through the form.

tags: 1 · التسجيل وملف المستفيد | Registration & Beneficiary File
get.summary: List orphan categories and which are served
get.description: Categories used for the eligibility gate.

tags: 1 · التسجيل وملف المستفيد | Registration & Beneficiary File
get.summary: List file types (new beneficiary vs foster family)
get.description: تسجيل مستفيد جديد for an independent beneficiary over 18; تسجيل اسرة بديلة for a host family caring for an orphan.

tags: 1 · التسجيل وملف المستفيد | Registration & Beneficiary File
get.description: What counts as اثبات ملكية السكن.

tags: 1 · التسجيل وملف المستفيد | Registration & Beneficiary File
get.description: Full file with all sections. Use for context before answering questions.

tags: 1 · التسجيل وملف المستفيد | Registration & Beneficiary File
patch.summary: Update one section of the data form
patch.description: Writes the values the caller dictated into a section (e.g. SEC-HOUSING). Only known fields for that section are accepted. Call completeness after to see what is still missing.

tags: 1 · التسجيل وملف المستفيد | Registration & Beneficiary File
get.summary: What is still missing from the file
get.description: THE KEY TOOL for follow-up. Returns completion %, the exact missing fields (with their section) and missing mandatory documents, plus whether the file is ready to submit. Use it to ask the beneficiary for precisely what is still needed instead of asking generically.

tags: 1 · التسجيل وملف المستفيد | Registration & Beneficiary File
post.summary: Submit the file for review (اضافة سجل)
post.description: Submits the completed file to the association for review. Blocked with 409 if mandatory fields or documents are still missing — surface the gaps to the caller rather than retrying.

tags: 1 · التسجيل وملف المستفيد | Registration & Beneficiary File
post.summary: Add a dependent (اضافة تابع)
post.description: Adds a household member. Everyone living permanently in the home must be added — spouse, children, siblings, foster mother, orphan siblings — because the household size drives the needs assessment.

tags: 1 · التسجيل وملف المستفيد | Registration & Beneficiary File
get.description: All household members with household size.

tags: 1 · التسجيل وملف المستفيد | Registration & Beneficiary File
get.description: The المرفقات checklist for this file with each document's status (missing / uploaded / verified / rejected / not_available / ineligible).

tags: 1 · التسجيل وملف المستفيد | Registration & Beneficiary File
patch.summary: Record a document as uploaded / not available / ineligible
patch.description: Sets a document's status. Per the guide: if the document does not apply (social security, citizen account) mark it 'ineligible' (عدم الاهلية); if it is unavailable (salary certificate) mark it 'not_available' (لا يوجد).

tags: 1 · التسجيل وملف المستفيد | Registration & Beneficiary File
get.summary: Get the financial profile & need score
get.description: Income, documented monthly obligations (الفواتير الشهرية), per-person living costs (التكاليف الشهرية للفرد), net income, per-capita income and the derived need score used for prioritization.

tags: 1 · التسجيل وملف المستفيد | Registration & Beneficiary File
post.summary: Add a documented monthly obligation
post.description: Adds to الفواتير الشهرية and recalculates net income, per-capita income and the need score.

tags: 1 · التسجيل وملف المستفيد | Registration & Beneficiary File
post.summary: Add a per-person monthly living cost
post.description: Adds to التكاليف الشهرية للفرد. Luxury/entertainment costs (PC-LUXURY) are rejected with 409 — they are not counted per the guide.

tags: 1 · التسجيل وملف المستفيد | Registration & Beneficiary File
get.description: What counts as الفواتير الشهرية.

tags: 1 · التسجيل وملف المستفيد | Registration & Beneficiary File
get.description: What counts (and what does not) as التكاليف الشهرية للفرد.

tags: 1 · التسجيل وملف المستفيد | Registration & Beneficiary File
get.description: Keyword search over the FAQ built from the association's guide (registration, eligibility, dependents, housing, finances, documents, requests, decisions). Use this before improvising an answer.
Lists tickets (التذاكر والطلبات). Filter by status, department, channel or beneficiary. Each row carries the SLA countdown like the admin panel.

post.summary: Open a ticket from any channel
post.description: Creates a ticket from a WhatsApp message or a phone call. If a phone is given the beneficiary is auto-matched. This is what the bot calls when it cannot resolve the query itself or when a human must act.

get.summary: Get a ticket with its full conversation
get.description: Full ticket detail including the message log (سجل المحادثة), SLA remaining, and the beneficiary's other tickets — the same context the agent screen shows.

patch.summary: Move a ticket across the kanban board
patch.description: Moves a ticket to another column (مفتوح / جاري العمل / بانتظار العميل / تم الرد / مغلق).

patch.summary: Assign a ticket to a staff member
patch.description: Assigns the ticket to a member of فريق العمل.

post.summary: Post a reply on a ticket
post.description: Adds an outbound message to the conversation and moves the ticket to 'replied'. If the WhatsApp 24h window has expired the response warns that only a template message may be sent.

get.description: Returns the board grouped into columns exactly as the admin panel renders it (مفتوح، جاري العمل، بانتظار العميل، تم الرد) with per-column counts and cards.
Totals by status, today's tickets, closure rate, average response time and the busiest department — the metric strip from the admin panel.
Routing targets (التصنيف) with each one's SLA in hours.
Staff available for assignment and escalation.

post.summary: Handle an inbound WhatsApp message
post.description: Entry point for the WhatsApp bot. Identifies the sender against the beneficiary database, opens or refreshes the 24-hour session window, and returns the caller's context (file status, open tickets, pending requests) so the agent can answer without asking who they are.

post.summary: Send a WhatsApp message
post.description: Sends a free-form message. Blocked with 409 if the 24-hour session window has closed — use /whatsapp/send-template instead.

post.summary: Send an approved WhatsApp template
post.description: Sends a pre-approved template message — the only thing permitted once the 24-hour window has closed.

get.description: Templates for OTP, registration confirmation, document requests, decisions, visit scheduling and payment notices.
Returns whether the 24-hour window is still open and how long remains (الوقت المتبقي).

tags: 4 · قناة الاتصال الهاتفي | Voice / SIP Channel
post.summary: Start a voice call session (SIP)
post.description: Called when a SIP call connects. Identifies the caller from the ANI, loads their context, and returns a ready greeting. The agent should NOT disclose file details until identity is confirmed for sensitive operations.

tags: 4 · قناة الاتصال الهاتفي | Voice / SIP Channel
post.summary: End a voice call and log the outcome
post.description: Closes the call session with its outcome, detected intent and duration for reporting.

tags: 4 · قناة الاتصال الهاتفي | Voice / SIP Channel
post.summary: Transfer a call to a human agent
post.description: Escalates a live call to a human, creating a ticket that carries the call context so the agent does not start cold.

tags: 4 · قناة الاتصال الهاتفي | Voice / SIP Channel
get.description: Recent voice sessions with outcome and detected intent, for reporting.
Everything the platform has sent in this session — useful to verify the bot actually notified the beneficiary.
برنامج علم، التاهيل والتدريب، جودة حياة، سكني، قيمي — each with its description and request-type count.

get.summary: List request types under a program
get.description: The projects/requests available under a program, with the approval ceiling and whether the support is recurring monthly or one-off.

get.summary: Find the right request type from free text
get.description: Maps what the beneficiary said (e.g. 'محتاج مساعدة في الايجار') to the correct request type and program. Use this before creating a request so the case lands in the right program.

post.summary: Submit a support request (طلب دعم)
post.description: Creates a support request under a program. Requires an APPROVED beneficiary file — returns 409 otherwise, matching the guide ('after your file is complete and approved'). Amounts above the request ceiling are rejected.

get.summary: Get a support request with its casework and decision
get.description: Full request detail including the case study steps and the committee decision if one has been issued.
All requests raised by a beneficiary with their stage and decision.

patch.summary: Append more detail to a request
patch.description: Use when the case worker or bot asks the beneficiary to explain further. Appends to وصف الحالة rather than overwriting it, preserving the history.

get.description: المقابلة المكتبية، المقابلة الالكترونية، الزيارة الميدانية، تقييم الوضع النفسي.

post.summary: Open a case study for a request
post.description: Starts دراسة الحالة and moves the request to 'under_study'. Assigns a social researcher.

post.summary: Schedule a case study step (visit / interview / assessment)
post.description: Schedules a field visit, office or online interview, or psychological assessment, and notifies the beneficiary on WhatsApp.

post.summary: Record findings for a completed step
post.description: Marks a case step complete and stores the researcher's findings.

post.summary: Submit the case to the specialized committee
post.description: Presents the case to اللجنة المختصة with the researcher's recommendation. Requires at least one completed step (409 otherwise).

post.summary: Record the committee decision and notify the beneficiary
post.description: Records قبول الطلب / طلب استكمال مستندات / الاعتذار, then notifies the beneficiary on BOTH WhatsApp and SMS as the guide specifies. Accepted requests become eligible for enrollment and disbursement.

get.description: The committee's queue, ordered by the beneficiary's need score so the highest-need cases surface first (support is given وفق الاحتياج والاولوية).

post.summary: Enrol an approved beneficiary into a program
post.description: Creates the enrollment for an ACCEPTED request and generates the monthly disbursement schedule. Returns 409 if the request was not accepted or is already enrolled.

get.description: Every program the beneficiary is enrolled in, with amounts and status.
The monthly transfer schedule with totals paid and upcoming — this answers 'كم اتحول لي وكم باقي'.

post.summary: Approve a disbursement for payment (التعميد بالصرف)
post.description: Moves a scheduled disbursement to approved so finance can pay it.

post.summary: Execute payment to the beneficiary's IBAN
post.description: Records a bank transfer against the disbursement and sends an SMS notice. Blocked (409) if the beneficiary has no IBAN on file.

get.description: All settled payments with bank reference numbers.
Everything due in the next N days across all beneficiaries — the monthly payment run the finance team executes.
Sponsor-to-beneficiary kafala records, restricted or unrestricted.
Association events with capacity and registration counts.

post.summary: Register a beneficiary for an event
post.description: Registers an approved beneficiary for an event; blocked when the event is full or already completed.

get.description: THE ONE CALL that returns everything about a beneficiary in one place: file status and completeness, household, documents, finances, every support request with its decision, enrollments, disbursements, payments, sponsorships, tickets and channel sessions. Use it to open any conversation with full context.

get.summary: Search beneficiaries by phone, name, file number or ID
get.description: Primary lookup for both channels — resolves a caller to their file. Phone matching accepts 05…, 9665…, +9665… formats.
Headline numbers across files, requests, programs, disbursements and channels — the management dashboard.
